- [USER] User inquired about eligibility criteria for credit cards, including income requirements and credit scores.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Credit card eligibility criteria include: 
  1. Income Requirements: Varies by card issuer and type; higher income generally means better options.
  2. Credit Score: Higher scores improve chances of approval; requirements differ by card type.
  3. Employment Status: Employment shows a regular income source; self-employed or unemployed applicants may face challenges.
  4. Credit History: Includes credit scores, payment history, and credit utilization; a good history offers more options.
  5. Age: Minimum age requirement varies from 18 to 21 years old, depending on issuer and type.
